assessment: Cardiac function is critically dependent on the homeostatic control of ATP so enough energy is provided for a given task and previous studies have described how calcium signals in the mitochondria convey a message of demand that regulates enzymes to alter ATP production accordingly. This manuscript presents a parallel mechanism that implicates CO2 and HCO3 sensors that regulate cAMP signalling. The authors have identified the putative location of the enzyme pathway following super-resolution imaging of isolated ventricular myocytes and mitochondria. Localizing sAC to the interior portion of the mitochondria is a significant advance and provides a framework for future target discovery.
